`.sdlc/runs/20261104-130720-feature-new-entity-rename-redirect/requirements.md` has been generated and validated for Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`, `feature-new`).

### Summary of `requirements.md`
- **In Scope (`IS-1`..`IS-7`) & Out of Scope (`OOS-1`..`OOS-6`)**: Strictly scoped to `@backstage/catalog-model`, `@backstage/plugin-catalog-backend`, `@backstage/catalog-client`, `@backstage/plugin-catalog`, `@backstage/plugin-techdocs`, and repo companions (API/SQL reports, docs, changesets) while keeping off-limits packages untouched.
- **Proposed Answers to the Four Design Questions (`DQ-1`..`DQ-4`, for Gate 1 confirmation)**:
  1. **Who may claim a former name (`DQ-1`)**: Entities declare former names/refs via `ANNOTATION_PREVIOUS_NAMES` (`backstage.io/previous-names`), parsed with `parseEntityRef` defaulting to the entity's own `kind` and `namespace`, restricted to the same `kind` (cross-kind and self-references ignored).
  2. **When a new entity takes an old name & competing claims (`DQ-2`)**: Live entities in `final_entities` always take precedence over former-name claims; if multiple live entities claim the same former ref, the lookup rejects the ambiguous claim (`404 Not Found`).
  3. **Permission checks on the redirect target (`DQ-3`)**: `AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog` evaluates `catalogEntityReadPermission` (`catalog.entity.read`) against the redirect target entity and returns `undefined` (`404 Not Found`) when unauthorized, preventing information disclosure.
  4. **Keeping existing lookups fast (`DQ-4`)**: `DefaultEntitiesCatalog.entitiesBatch` (`GET /entities/by-name/...` and `POST /entities/by-refs`) is unmodified on its primary path; former names are stored in a dedicated indexed table (`final_entity_previous_names`) and queried only on the 404 fallback path.
- **Functional Requirements (`FR-1`..`FR-16`)**, **Non-Functional Requirements (`NFR-1`..`NFR-5`)**, **PII Inventory**, **Role Matrix**, **Executable Acceptance Criteria (`AC-1`..`AC-10`)**, and **Open Questions for HITL (`OQ-1`..`OQ-4`)**.
